read_only_review.health: Four owned permits bound started fence tasks. HTTP timeout/disconnect detaches rather than cancels journal work. Only a fresh successful fence returns 200. Stuck storage can hold all four checks indefinitely and yields 503, not cached readiness.
read_only_review.polling: Actual EngineConfig accepts integer/string 1..5 seconds, default1. Only ordinary pending/accepted-send delays change; exact identity, journal-before-Redis, finalized receipt, expiry park and finite send/check budgets remain. Longer settings trade confirmation/resend latency and count-budget wall time for reduced polling.
read_only_review.batching: New nonce consumption per cycle is min(inflight budget,256), counting uncertain outcomes; concurrency32 and ten-iteration limit unchanged. Not an all-work bound: deterministic preparation failures can repeat, and recovery/recycled work is separate.
read_only_review.depth: Positive depth persists qualified boundary latest-depth, not latest tip. Receipt/checkpoint/head rereads and durable continuity checks remain; positive depth adds two block reads. Existing old-tip checkpoints remain conservative until catchup and are not silently rewritten.
